target.title: fix(imessage): remove split-send coalescing config
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #91243. Replaces #107182 with a clean branch based on current `main` after the old PR became noisy/conflicted.

The iMessage plugin still exposed OpenClaw-side split-send coalescing config even though current `imsg` owns Apple URL-preview coalescing before OpenClaw receives messages. That left stale config/default surface area and confused upgrade proof.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Removes the retired `channels.imessage.coalesceSameSenderDms` config/default/schema surface and the iMessage-specific URL-preview bucket policy.
- Keeps the generic inbound debounce merge helper for configured `messages.inbound` batching, with narrow caps and tests.
- Adds iMessage doctor legacy rules so `openclaw doctor --fix` removes retired root/account keys.
- Lets doctor repair plugin-owned legacy config before strict runtime reads, without masking unrelated malformed plugin config.
- Requires `imsg >= 0.13.1`, the first planned release containing the proven GUID-linked URL-preview fix; released `0.13.0` and `0.13.1` prereleases fail the channel probe with upgrade guidance.
- Refreshes generated config, bundled channel metadata, and Plugin SDK API baselines.

## User Impact

Existing users no longer need or see the retired iMessage coalescing knob. Users upgrading with stale `coalesceSameSenderDms` config get a doctor repair path instead of runtime fallback behavior. Malformed non-legacy plugin config still fails closed and can recover from last-known-good during doctor repair. Until `imsg 0.13.1` is published, this PR must remain draft because every currently released `imsg` build is below the new floor.

## Evidence

Exact head: `0a143a32f4f77bfdf3e51a7438d570d25545b09a`.

- `git diff --check` passed.
- `node --import tsx scripts/generate-config-doc-baseline.ts --check` passed: `OK docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256`.
- `node --import tsx scripts/generate-bundled-channel-config-metadata.ts --check` passed.
- `node --max-old-space-size=8192 --import tsx scripts/generate-plugin-sdk-api-baseline.ts --check` passed: `OK docs/.generated/plugin-sdk-api-baseline.sha256`.
- `node --import tsx scripts/check-import-cycles.ts` passed: `Import cycle check: 0 runtime value cycle(s).`
- Final-head focused proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-config-preflight.test.ts extensions/imessage/src/status.test.ts extensions/imessage/src/doctor-contract-api.test.ts extensions/imessage/doctor-contract-api.test.ts` passed 2 Vitest shards, 4 files, 56 tests.
- The version-boundary tests reject released `imsg 0.13.0`, reject `0.13.1-beta.1`, accept final `0.13.1`, and provide the Homebrew upgrade command in the fatal probe error.
- The mixed-config regression proves a retired `coalesceSameSenderDms` key cannot hide an unrelated malformed iMessage plugin value: doctor restores last-known-good instead of accepting the unvalidated snapshot.
- Pre-rebase isolated upgrade proof on head `a79a39262782f78b9d399c18b0848242e32fa46d`: with `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` and `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` pointed at a temp config containing both `channels.imessage.coalesceSameSenderDms` and `channels.imessage.accounts.work.coalesceSameSenderDms`, `pnpm openclaw doctor --fix --non-interactive --yes` exited `0`. Before: `{root:true, account:true}`. After: `{root:false, account:false}`. Doctor output included `Removed retired channels.imessage.coalesceSameSenderDms.` and `Removed retired channels.imessage.accounts.work.coalesceSameSenderDms.` Current-head doctor migration and mixed-validation behavior are covered by the 56-test focused proof above.
- Rebased full changed-surface gate passed in Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxr93etdsfcwqaspj4q9fxtj`: max-lines, generated baselines, dependency pins, typecheck (core/core tests/extensions/extension tests), core and extension lint, plugin boundaries, runtime cycles, and database/config guards all passed. Run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29589872439.
- Fresh autoreview found the mixed plugin-validation hole and stale messages documentation; both were fixed and the follow-up uncommitted review found no remaining issue in that patch. Its only remaining finding is the intentional draft blocker that `imsg 0.13.1` is not published.
- Upstream exact-head live proof: `openclaw/imsg#181` head `bbbc56b5a4a38e0e9e5d5b2f06fd6bd083ae8e6b` was tested on macOS 26.4.1 with two real Messages compositions. Each composition produced two structurally linked physical rows and exactly one patched `imsg watch --json` event, with no delayed duplicate during a 30-second observation window. Sanitized evidence: https://github.com/openclaw/imsg/pull/181#issuecomment-4999327788.
- OpenClaw exact head `a79a39262782f78b9d399c18b0848242e32fa46d` ingested the coalesced event once. A successful model reply is not claimed because the disposable downstream environment separately hit legacy workspace/auth setup failures; the Messages-to-`imsg watch` ownership boundary is proven directly upstream.

Remaining dependency gate: the proven GUID-linked coalescing fix is not present in released `imsg 0.13.0`. Keep this PR draft until `openclaw/imsg#181` is merged and `imsg 0.13.1` containing that fix is published. After publication, rerun the live command-plus-URL scenario with the packaged `imsg 0.13.1` binary and this exact OpenClaw head before marking the PR ready.
